mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_live_recovery_case (case_id, credential_id, symbol, dispatch_key, operation_type, recovery_mode, requested_by, evidence_sha256, expected_exchange_order_id, expected_client_order_id, state, created_at) SELECT #{caseId}, g.credential_id, g.symbol, t.idempotency_key, t.operation_type, 'TICKETED', #{requesterId}, #{evidenceHash}, t.exchange_order_id, t.client_order_id, 'PENDING', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM quant_live_dispatch_guard g JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket t ON t.credential_id=g.credential_id AND t.symbol=g.symbol AND t.idempotency_key=g.active_dispatch_key WHERE g.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND g.symbol=#{symbol} AND g.active_dispatch_key=#{dispatchKey} AND t.dispatch_status IN ('UNKNOWN','DISPATCHING') AND t.operation_type IN ('OPEN','CLOSE','CANCEL') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_live_recovery_case c WHERE c.credential_id=g.credential_id AND c.symbol=g.symbol AND c.dispatch_key=t.idempotency_key AND c.state IN ('PENDING','APPROVED') )

INSERT INTO quant_live_recovery_case (case_id, credential_id, symbol, dispatch_key, operation_type, recovery_mode, requested_by, evidence_sha256, expected_exchange_order_id, expected_client_order_id, state, created_at) SELECT #{caseId}, e.credential_id, e.symbol, e.idempotency_key, 'OPEN', 'LEGACY_TESTNET_OPEN', #{requesterId}, #{evidenceHash}, NULL, e.client_order_id, 'PENDING', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM quant_execution_record e JOIN quant_credential q ON q.id=e.credential_id AND q.run_mode='TESTNET' AND q.del_flag='0' JOIN quant_live_dispatch_guard g ON g.credential_id=e.credential_id AND g.symbol=e.symbol JOIN quant_strategy_position_state s ON s.instance_id=e.strategy_instance_id WHERE e.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND e.symbol=#{symbol} AND e.idempotency_key=#{dispatchKey} AND e.operation_type='OPEN' AND e.execution_status='UNKNOWN' AND e.exchange_order_id IS NULL AND e.client_order_id IS NOT NULL AND e.client_order_id<>'' AND e.strategy_id IS NOT NULL AND e.strategy_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND g.active_dispatch_key IS NULL AND s.status='OPEN_PENDING' AND s.pending_action='OPEN' AND s.pending_idempotency_key=e.idempotency_key AND s.pending_client_order_id=e.client_order_id AND s.pending_order_id IS NULL AND s.position_id IS NULL AND s.position_qty>0 AND s.recovery_required='1' AND s.unsafe_recovery='1' AND s.position_cycle_key IS NOT NULL AND s.position_cycle_key<>'' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_order_dispatch_ticket t WHERE t.credential_id=e.credential_id AND t.symbol=e.symbol AND t.idempotency_key=e.idempotency_key ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_live_recovery_case c WHERE c.credential_id=e.credential_id AND c.symbol=e.symbol AND c.dispatch_key=e.idempotency_key AND c.state IN ('PENDING','APPROVED') )
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_live_recovery_case SET state='APPROVED', reviewed_by=#{reviewerId}, reviewed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE case_id=#{caseId} AND state='PENDING' AND requested_by<>#{reviewerId} AND evidence_sha256=#{evidenceHash} AND ( (recovery_mode='TICKETED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_live_dispatch_guard g JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket t ON t.credential_id=g.credential_id AND t.symbol=g.symbol AND t.idempotency_key=g.active_dispatch_key WHERE g.credential_id=quant_live_recovery_case.credential_id AND g.symbol=quant_live_recovery_case.symbol AND g.active_dispatch_key=quant_live_recovery_case.dispatch_key AND t.operation_type=quant_live_recovery_case.operation_type AND t.client_order_id=quant_live_recovery_case.expected_client_order_id AND (t.exchange_order_id <=> quant_live_recovery_case.expected_exchange_order_id) AND t.dispatch_status IN ('UNKNOWN','DISPATCHING') )) OR (recovery_mode='LEGACY_TESTNET_OPEN' AND operation_type='OPEN' AND expected_exchange_order_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_credential q WHERE q.id=quant_live_recovery_case.credential_id AND q.run_mode='TESTNET' AND q.del_flag='0' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_live_dispatch_guard g WHERE g.credential_id=quant_live_recovery_case.credential_id AND g.symbol=quant_live_recovery_case.symbol AND g.active_dispatch_key IS NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_order_dispatch_ticket t WHERE t.credential_id=quant_live_recovery_case.credential_id AND t.symbol=quant_live_recovery_case.symbol AND t.idempotency_key=quant_live_recovery_case.dispatch_key ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_execution_record e WHERE e.credential_id=quant_live_recovery_case.credential_id AND e.symbol=quant_live_recovery_case.symbol AND e.idempotency_key=quant_live_recovery_case.dispatch_key AND e.operation_type='OPEN' AND e.execution_status='UNKNOWN' AND e.exchange_order_id IS NULL AND e.client_order_id=quant_live_recovery_case.expected_client_order_id ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_strategy_position_state s JOIN quant_execution_record e ON e.strategy_instance_id=s.instance_id WHERE e.credential_id=quant_live_recovery_case.credential_id AND e.symbol=quant_live_recovery_case.symbol AND e.idempotency_key=quant_live_recovery_case.dispatch_key AND s.status='OPEN_PENDING' AND s.pending_action='OPEN' AND s.pending_idempotency_key=e.idempotency_key AND s.pending_client_order_id=e.client_order_id AND s.pending_order_id IS NULL AND s.position_id IS NULL AND s.position_qty>0 AND s.recovery_required='1' AND s.unsafe_recovery='1' ) )) )
mapper.select: SELECT case_id, credential_id, symbol, dispatch_key, operation_type, recovery_mode, requested_by, reviewed_by, evidence_sha256, expected_exchange_order_id, expected_client_order_id, state FROM quant_live_recovery_case WHERE case_id=#{caseId}
